title: Jammy Jolted Korean Hazelnut Tteok
description: A traditional Korean dish with a twist, featuring shelled hazelnuts and ferment-jang, this Whole30-friendly tteok is both energizing and delicious. It is made with natural ingredients and no added sugars.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, grind the chopped hazelnuts into a fine meal.
In a large bowl, whisk together the hazelnut meal, coconut flour, coconut sugar, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and ferment-jang.
Add the egg mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a small ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place on a slate tile lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with ghee and bake for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
